metadata.title: Organisation Profile: SC-28 + SC-28(1) (Moderate)
metadata.remarks: Organisation tailoring layered on the NIST MODERATE extract (profiles/sc28-moderate), which is left untouched. This profile holds the organisation-wide decisions only, in technology-agnostic terms: parameter values and constraints, and added guidance. System-specific values and implementation status belong in the SSP. sc-28_odp.01 is a selection parameter: in OSCAL 1.2 a profile cannot give it a value, so a constraint states what must be selected and the SSP records the selection.

constraints.description: Both confidentiality and integrity must be selected.

tests.remarks: Informative expression; evaluated by people and the assessment plan, not by tooling.

values: all organisational information held in production data stores, including logs and backups
all organisational information held in production data stores, including logs and backups
production data stores and their backup media

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: Organisation guidance for sc-28.1_obj-2 (prevent unauthorized modification): cryptographic tamper evidence, where every change to stored data is recorded in a cryptographic hash chain whose digests are held outside the data store, is accepted as the mechanism, provided the evidence is verified regularly. It detects rather than prevents modification; encryption at rest alone is not accepted for obj-2.
